cards.shot_design: 24mm locked wide; radio booth geometry, red ON AIR lamp and broadcast clock share the frame
cards.action: Lin Che rides the last music bed and watches the second hand reach the handoff

cards.continuity_model: Night practicals; Lin Che face/hair/coat lock; no bottle yet

cards.shot_design: 85mm slow push from right hand on fader to held breath and eyes
cards.action: She completes a precise fade while fatigue appears only in a brief pause
cards.sound_edit: Fader travel and held breath isolated under thinning music
cards.continuity_model: Right-hand action, eyeline and desk axis locked from S01

cards.shot_design: 50mm tabletop rack focus from folded note to sealed cold-brew bottle
cards.action: Her hand stops beside the bottle but does not take it yet

cards.continuity_model: Verified white label, black cap, sealed state; note remains folded and attached

cards.shot_design: 75mm profile slider with phone waveform reflected in booth glass

cards.continuity_model: Umbrella opens once, stays in right hand, fabric becomes visibly wet

cards.shot_design: 50mm locked medium, then a controlled rack focus to the bus bay
